verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP docs and founder description confirm the assistant can answer questions about mailbox content and specific threads, i.e., 'chat with your inbox' (zero-docs-9, zero-docs-14, zero-comm-1), satisfying the email-Q&A part of the story. However, there is no evidence of any calendar integration or calendar-grounded answers anywhere in the evidence pack, so the 'whole inbox and calendar' scope is only half delivered. Missing for 10: calendar data access/integration, cross-thread synthesis of 'what's outstanding' across the whole inbox (only single-thread Q&A is documented), and independent hands-on verification of answer groundedness.
